name: Mirrorform

xmage_helpers_reviewed.note: Both complete copyPermanent overloads reviewed; no claim of a full broad GameImpl audit.

rules_notes.interpretation: Freezes the target recipe and current controlled nonland recipient set, then installs simultaneous permanent copy overlays without entry events. Preserves physical/token identity, native face shape, counters, tap/damage/control/ownership and external effects; rebuilds intrinsic providers with one copy-effect timestamp. Native identity returns only after departure LKI/replacement capture. Newly acquired linked ability pairs have distinct epochs and undefined prior entry choices. Planeswalker loyalty-use allowance persists across intermediate type loss. Copies of transformed faces use explicit physical shape and correct mana value. A copied chosen-type mana restriction with no corresponding choice produces frozen unspendable lots rather than inventing a type or failing; those lots remain unspendable after source departure.

test_scope_notes: Paid Mirrorform and public raw/index/restore actions exercise ordinary targeting, complete copying, layer interaction, token identity and departure. Native transformation, sparse linked-cost setup and forced clock exhaustion are explicitly typed boundary fixtures; they are not claimed as new casting/transform cost implementations.
The copied Changeling exception is tested through the shared copy core for the subsequent Omni-Changeling consumer.

Generic permanent-spell normalization is tested at an explicitly typed stack-copy allocator boundary for creatures, Auras, planeswalkers, DFCs and evoke; the integrator authors the real conspire consumer separately.
